// permissions: Bash rules are specific command prefixes; Read/Write accept path globs. Run /permissions inside Claude Code to manage these interactively.
// hooks: Hooks are deterministic shell commands wired into Claude's tool-call lifecycle. This one auto-fixes lint after every Edit inside src/.

hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH; case "$file" in ./src/*) npm run lint -- --fix "$file" ;; esac'
